text:
lia: Heads-up RFC: introduce X-Rd-RouteMeta to carry route_id + sampling hint + small attrs. avoids collision with tenant keys. will open PR.

ben: Quick: does this change billing/quota? we need to tell finance if requests counted differently.

lia: No billing change. Every accepted request still counts against quota. The meta is for telemetry, routing heuristics, and optional sampling.

ryan: SDK impact: current libs send a short route token string. Adding JSON per request is heavy for high-TP clients. We need a compact option.

samira: Suggestion: accept three wire forms: token-string, compact-base64-json, or plain-json. Servers resolve token -> metadata for compact path. SDKs default to token unless `enable_route_meta=true`.

lia: Good. server rules: accept all three, validate JSON, cap expanded meta to 4096 bytes, and emit `route.meta.truncated` when we strip attributes. Invalid base64 -> 400.

ben: Telemetry naming: keep `route.requests.total` for all requests, add `route.requests.sampled` when sample flag present. Also add `route.meta.size_bytes` histogram.

ryan: SDK changes (py/ts/go): add config `routeMeta: 'token'|'base64'|'json'` default 'token'. Provide helper `client.setRouteMeta({...})`. Add deprecation warning if old header `X-Route` detected by server later.

samira: Also include a tiny opt-in telemetry ping `route_meta.mode` so we can track adoption counts without PII.

lia: Ops: rate-limit expanded meta per tenant (default 100 rps) and expose `route.meta.rejected_rate_limit`. This prevents ingestion bursts.

ci-bot: CI started: server/routemeta-accept-formats PR by lia.

ryan: e2e tests needed: python sends token, ts sends base64, go sends json with enable flag. Ensure metrics emitted and no quota mismatch. I'll draft tests.

ben: Product: console needs a small sampled-ratio gauge and a flag per-route showing metadata enabled. Can we FF the console tile?

lia: Yes. rollout plan: FF server accept both formats (week1), SDK releases with compatibility (week2), console tile behind FF (week3), enable opt-in for select customers and collect telemetry (week4). Deprecate legacy header after 8 weeks.

ryan: minor UX ask: SDKs should print a local migration hint: `rwctl route-meta status` or a one-line log on startup when `routeMeta!=token`.

lia: I'll add an ADR section in the PR describing compatibility and fallback rules. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
